title: NoSQL
description: Can model documents for a workload that tables fit poorly, query nested fields, and say which invariants still belong in a relational store.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can insert and read a document, point at a nested field in the shape, and state that NoSQL is not 'no schema' — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can add MongoDB beside an existing PostgreSQL service, write and read a document through a committed path, filter on a nested field, and name one invariant Postgres still enforces that the document store does not.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently choose a document shape for a stated workload, add indexes that match the actual queries, and write a decision memo covering consistency, join or aggregation cost, schema evolution and duplicated-data update risk.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a projection or dual-write failure where the document looked fine, show a stale or duplicated field, and defend which facts stay in PostgreSQL versus MongoDB when a write crosses both.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's collection, name a copied-relational model or a missing uniqueness claim, and teach when a document store is the wrong default on an unfamiliar workload.
